# anaume

Package for generating analysis results for PMDA Query regarding adverse
event in oncology therapeutic area
[anaume](https://github.com/phuse-org/anaume)

## Purpose

To Create analysis results for PMDA Query regarding adverse event in
oncology therapeutic area.

## Installation

Install the current release from CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("anaume")
```

Install the development version from GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("phuse-org/anaume")
```

### Dependencies

The latest version of the package works with the latest versions of the
packages stated in `DESCRIPTION`.

## R Versions

Here’s a summary of our strategy for this package related to R versions:

- R versions for developers and users will be covered from R4.2.0.

## Contact

For bug reports and feature requests, please open an issue on
[GitHub](https://github.com/phuse-org/anaume/issues).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`adae`](https://phuse-org.github.io/anaume/reference/adae.md) :
  Example ADAE dataset

- [`adsl`](https://phuse-org.github.io/anaume/reference/adsl.md) :
  Example ADSL dataset

- [`ae_id()`](https://phuse-org.github.io/anaume/reference/ae_id.md)
  [`ae_label()`](https://phuse-org.github.io/anaume/reference/ae_id.md)
  [`ae_condition()`](https://phuse-org.github.io/anaume/reference/ae_id.md)
  :

  Get properties of an `ae_type` object

- [`jpn_query_aggregate()`](https://phuse-org.github.io/anaume/reference/jpn_query_aggregate.md)
  : Create ARD (analysis ready data) for adverse event summaries
  (aggregate wrapper)

- [`jpn_query_overview()`](https://phuse-org.github.io/anaume/reference/jpn_query_overview.md)
  : Create ARD for adverse event overview (AETYPE level only)

- [`jpn_query_ptsummary()`](https://phuse-org.github.io/anaume/reference/jpn_query_ptsummary.md)
  : Create ARD for adverse event overview (by AETYPE and PT(AEDECOD))

- [`make_ae_type()`](https://phuse-org.github.io/anaume/reference/make_ae_type.md)
  :

  Create an `ae_type` object

- [`merge_ae_types()`](https://phuse-org.github.io/anaume/reference/merge_ae_types.md)
  :

  Combine multiple `ae_type` objects
